invariants.rationale: The method expects preppedInputRecord to be a prepared input, which is unlikely to be null at method entry.
userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner should often be set (as an Option) before bulk insert operation is executed.
The size() of a List is always non-negative.
Option.isPresent() or its negation always holds, as userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner is an Option.
preppedInputRecord is declared as List, so this will always be true at entry.
